works.title: The Adversarial AI Agent
works.description: A technically-framed systems design book with 31 chapters plus three appendix sections, serving as a companion to Natural Language Programming for AI Agents. Covers architecture, pipeline design, failure modes, RAG, security, PKM, hardware, and deployable specifications. Positioned as design rationale for practitioners building AI systems.
works.quote: The book is a technically-framed systems design companion to Natural Language Programming for AI Agents — 31 chapters plus three appendix sections

works.title: Ora Online Services Platform and Business Model
works.description: A documented strategic direction for Ora as a public-facing service offering, including a free demonstration website with limited queries, a model-agnostic routing layer API, and a pipeline orchestration service. Includes detailed business plan with three-tier pricing, $2M seed valuation, 18-24 month runway, and retention-driven Series A strategy.
works.quote: Give me a detailed summary of the public demonstration site and the associated business plan in a markdown file, including the specific decisions I made. I want to capture this for further development later.

works.title: Federated Product Index Network
works.description: A decentralized peer-to-peer product discovery and indexing architecture designed to bypass tech platform monopolies and return search control to consumers. Includes raw HTML and JSON storage with provenance chains, anti-scraping defenses, federation protocols, and optional IPFS mirroring. Enables open-source product indexing as an alternative to Amazon, eBay, and other walled silos.
works.quote: If they had made one open-source index—which Google could have done and was on track to do—they would have cut off the chokepoint for everybody
